name: dockrepair-bench-unhealthy
services:
  app:
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - while true; do sleep 3600; done
    depends_on:
      cache:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    image: busybox:1.36
    networks:
      default: null
  cache:
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - touch /tmp/healthy; while true; do sleep 3600; done
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - test
        - -f
        - /tmp/healthy
      timeout: 1s
      interval: 1s
      retries: 1
    image: busybox:1.36
    networks:
      default: null
networks:
  default:
    name: dockrepair-bench-unhealthy_default
